# Kitchen Decorators

> Dulux Accredited kitchen respray specialists serving Winchester, Southampton and the whole of Hampshire, UK. We transform kitchens by respraying cabinet doors, drawer fronts and frames — complete in 5 days with only 2 afternoons of disruption in your home, for up to 75% less than the cost of a new kitchen. Rated 5.0 from 67 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- Business: Kitchen Decorators (also listed on Google as “The Kitchen Decorating Co”) — kitchen respraying and hand-painted kitchen cabinet finishes only (not a general spray shop)
- Accreditation: Dulux Accredited Kitchen Sprayer
- Phone: 01962 458055
- Email: info@kitchendecorators.co.uk
- Workshop: Unit 4A, Bridge Farm Industries, Botley Rd, Curbridge, Southampton SO30 2HB
- Rating: 5.0 stars from 67 Google reviews
- Turnaround: 5 days total; only 2 afternoons of on-site disruption; kitchen usable the same day
- Doors and drawer fronts sprayed off-site in a dust-free workshop; frames masked and sprayed in place
- Paint: specialist kitchen paint, colour matched to Dulux, Farrow & Ball, Little Greene and Edward Bulmer
- Cost: up to 75% less than replacing the kitchen
- Free no-obligation quotes and colour consultation
- MDF, wood, laminate and previously painted doors can all be sprayed

## Service areas

Winchester, Southampton, Eastleigh, Romsey, Andover, Chandler's Ford, Hedge End, Colden Common, Botley, Salisbury, Basingstoke, Farnham, Alton, Portsmouth, Fareham, Petersfield — and the whole of Southern England.
